title: blobs.register request
description: A writer registers ownership of an object in UA1_BLOBS with the team services, confirming whether the object is already live or must be uploaded first.

request_id.description: The host's id for this registration request; a retry keeps it.

sha256.description: The unpadded base64url SHA-256 digest of the blob's bytes.

owner.description: The work or system agent that holds this blob for its retention window.

agent_id.description: The system work's agent id (matching UA-Blob-Agent).

person.description: Opaque reference to the person whose work stored this blob (matching UA-Blob-Person); required when owner.type is request and absent for system work.
